title: TOCFL Novice 1 · Getting Started
subtitle: Taiwan Mandarin Beginner
description: Begin your journey with Taiwan's official Chinese proficiency test. Learn greetings, numbers, and basic expressions in Traditional characters.
objectives: Greet and introduce yourself in Taiwan Mandarin
Use basic numbers and time expressions
Understand and use common Taiwan-specific vocabulary
Read and write basic Traditional Chinese characters
Order food and ask simple prices

title: TOCFL Novice 2 · Daily Life in Taiwan
subtitle: Taiwan Mandarin Elementary
description: Navigate daily situations in Taiwan: transportation, weather, shopping, and dining with appropriate politeness levels.
objectives: Ask for and give directions using Taiwan place names
Talk about weather and seasons in Taiwan
Shop at night markets and traditional markets
Order food and make simple requests politely
Use Taiwan-specific measure words and particles
Describe daily routines and simple plans
